card.name:
[[[
  const s = entity.state;
  return s === 'locked' ? 'Locked'
       : s === 'unlocked' ? 'Unlocked'
       : s === 'open' ? 'Open'
       : s === 'locking' ? 'Locking\u2026'
       : s === 'unlocking' ? 'Unlocking\u2026'
       : s === 'opening' ? 'Opening\u2026'
       : s === 'jammed' ? 'Jammed'
       : 'Unavailable';
]]]
